international.summary: At least 24 people have been killed after a boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsized in Nigeria.

international.title: Netanyahu rival condemns settler arson attacks on Palestinian villages in West Bank
international.summary: Dozens of militant Israeli settlers raided communities on Saturday night, setting fire to vehicles and several homes Arson attacks by militant Israeli settlers on Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank have caused a political row in Israel, drawing condemnation from Gadi Eisenkot, the opposition leader, who described them as “Jewish terrorism”. Dozens of settlers raided Palestinian communities overnight on Saturday, setting fire to about a dozen vehicles and several homes and scrawling racist graffiti. At least four communities were attacked. Israeli police said they had launched an investigation with forensic teams. Continue reading...

international.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
international.summary: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.
